operations.purpose: Generate one seeded fold/fault displacement map, not field-conditioned geology.
operations.input_contract: shape=(time_samples,traces), seed=integer; optional existing generator parameters in sample/trace units
operations.output_contract: Deformation with vertical/horizontal [time,trace] displacements in samples and metadata
operations.applicability: synthetic deformation only; fault metadata is not a field interpretation
operations.determinism: same seed and inputs reproduce maps

operations.purpose: Apply one displacement map coherently to related arrays.
operations.input_contract: mapping of [time,trace] or [channel,time,trace] arrays; Deformation; explicit categorical keys
operations.output_contract: new mapping, same keys/shapes; nearest boundary extrapolation; categorical order 0, continuous order 1
operations.applicability: coordinate warp only; no elastic/fluid modeling or physical-bound enforcement

operations.purpose: Convert isotropic Vp/Vs/density to saturated bulk/shear moduli.
operations.input_contract: matching finite arrays; Vp,Vs m/s; density g/cc; Vp>Vs>0
operations.applicability: isotropic elastic states, positive bulk modulus

operations.purpose: Convert positive isotropic bulk/shear moduli and density to velocities.
operations.input_contract: matching finite arrays; K,G GPa; density g/cc; all positive
operations.output_contract: ElasticProperties Vp,Vs m/s and density g/cc, matching shape, float64

operations.purpose: Evaluate NaCl-brine density, acoustic velocity, and bulk modulus.
operations.input_contract: pressure MPa [5,60], temperature degC [20,100], NaCl mass fraction [0,0.32]
operations.output_contract: FluidPropertyState: density g/cc, velocity m/s, K GPa, phase/model provenance
operations.applicability: empirical correlation support only; no extrapolation

operations.purpose: Evaluate a supported pure-CO2 single-phase state.
operations.input_contract: pressure MPa, temperature degC; supercritical required by default
operations.output_contract: FluidPropertyState: density g/cc, velocity m/s, K GPa, phase/model version
operations.applicability: CoolProp fluid limits; reject two-phase/unknown/critical states
operations.determinism: deterministic for a pinned CoolProp version

operations.purpose: Exact PP interface reflectivity, not convolved seismic.
operations.input_contract: matching finite Vp,Vs m/s and density g/cc [time,trace]; increasing angles deg within [0,55]; pre-critical only
operations.output_contract: float64 [angle,time,trace], first time sample zero, dimensionless coefficients
operations.applicability: isotropic elastic interfaces; post-critical real-part-only workflow is rejected at facade boundary
operations.resources: CPU, dense 4x4 solve per interface and angle

operations.purpose: Exact PP reflectivity, angle-specific wavelet convolution, global-sample mute, shared-endpoint near/mid/far stacks.
operations.input_contract: matching finite elastic [time,trace] with Vp,Vs m/s and density g/cc; ForwardModelSpecification; nonnegative global sample_origin
operations.output_contract: ForwardResult: float32 reflectivity/seismic [angle,time,trace], stacks [3,time,trace], angles deg and ordered band names
operations.calibration_or_data: caller-supplied ForwardModelSpecification; wavelet/angle choices not inferred
operations.applicability: isotropic pre-critical PP; constant-zero same convolution; mute uses global sample origin

operations.purpose: Compare two independent near/mid/far outputs without declaring either ground truth.
operations.input_contract: matching [3,time,trace] arrays in the same amplitude units and alignment; pairwise finite support
operations.output_contract: ForwardAgreement per band: least-squares scale, correlation, normalized RMSE
operations.applicability: diagnostic agreement, not field validity or uncertainty quantification

operations.input_contract: finite RGT [time,trace] in caller-defined relative-time units; tolerance in same units
operations.applicability: coordinate QC only; does not certify fault-safe reflector identity

operations.purpose: Render existing truth/prior/prediction arrays; no scientific recomputation.
operations.input_contract: matching [3,time,trace] arrays, Vp/Vs m/s and density g/cc
operations.applicability: comparison visualization only; titles are inherited from source renderer

operations.purpose: Apply approved same-frame calibrated differential Gassmann only inside a declared region.
operations.input_contract: brine [3,time,trace] Vp/Vs m/s,density g/cc; matching porosity,shaliness,saturation fractions,depth m,boolean region; CalibratedDryFrameModel, FluidRockPhysics, SupportAcceptanceContract
operations.output_contract: CalibratedFluidApplication with elastic [3,time,trace], unchanged outside region, calibration ID and support diagnostics
operations.calibration_or_data: required approved calibration and support contract; synthetic unit fixtures are not field approval
operations.applicability: all substituted pixels must pass a conservative per-pixel calibration-distance and physical-domain gate; not complete production realization acceptance
operations.resources: CPU, neighbor search on selected pixels

operations.input_contract: field RGT/horizons/elastic backgrounds, calibrated reservoir model and masks

operations.purpose: Research graph construction and learned inversion.
